subpages.title: Ethernet Switches – Grid Connect
subpages.desc: Ethernet switches managed and unmanaged. 5 port, 8 port and 16 port available. Prices start at $69. Most switches have small thin profile for easy DIN rail mounting and minimal use of panel space. They can use either AC or DC power. The EIBA5 is ideal for shallow cabinets; enclosure is rated IP30.
